messages:
From: Sara King <sara.king@wellio.com>

Cc: Wellio Security Team <security@wellio.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up — data handling attestation & artifacts

Diego,

Thanks for the SIG response your team submitted last week. Wellio's InfoSec reviewers flagged a few clarifications we need before we can clear Redwood in our security review:

- Confirmation whether customer prompts and generated outputs are ever used for model training or offline fine-tuning (explicit yes/no and the legal basis if yes).
- Retention durations for prompt logs, inference traces, and KV cache entries by default and for customers who opt into extended logging.
- Whether ephemeral caches (KV/prefix caches) are written to durable storage at any point.
- Proof artifacts: sample redacted prompt-log snippet, KMS key policy, and an attestation that training on customer content is disabled for our tenancy.

If you can provide concise answers and the evidence pack (PDF + a small sample), we can move this through our compliance gate. Appreciate a response this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sara King
Director, Security Operations — Wellio
[sara.king@wellio.com]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara King <sara.king@wellio.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — data handling attestation & artifacts

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, followed by what I'm attaching and next steps.

Short answers
- Training on customer content: No. Redwood does not use customer-provided prompts, responses, or embeddings to train or fine-tune our public or private model weights unless there is an explicit written agreement; that includes all hosted and dedicated deployments.
- Default retention: prompt/request logs (ephemeral logs) are retained for 7 days by default and purged automatically; embeddings-only telemetry stored for 30 days for billing and monitoring by default.
- Extended logging: Customers can opt into longer retention windows (30/90/365 days) via contract. Data retention for extended logging is configurable per-account and documented in the contract addendum.
- KV/prefix caches: Inference runtime keeps KV cache in memory for the duration of a session; we do not persist KV cache to durable storage in normal operation. If session snapshots are enabled for debugging by a customer, they are explicitly stored only when customer-authorized and encrypted at rest.

Attachments and artifacts (attached to this thread)
- redwood-sig-data-retention-2026.pdf — our written statement of retention policy, opt-in flows, and purge schedules.
- sample-promptlog-snippet-iso.txt — heavily redacted prompt log demonstrating default redaction and anonymization (no customer identifiers).
- kms-architecture-diagram.png — high-level KMS/HSM integration diagram showing envelope encryption and key separation per-tenant.
- redwood-non-training-attestation.txt — signed attestation from Applied ML / Privacy stating customer content is not used for training absent written consent.

I've looped in Mina (Security) for any deep crypto/KMS follow-ups and Irene (Legal) for contractual language. Markus (Product) is included for implementation detail.

Next steps
1) Review the attached PDF and sample.
2) If you need a signed copy with Wellio's PO or an executed NDA, Irene can advise on the exact form.
3) If you want a short technical walkthrough of runtime behavior (KV cache, snapshot workflow), Markus can join a 30-minute call.

Happy to set times.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Diego — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups after an internal review:

- The redacted prompt log looks fine, but our reviewers want a second sample that includes a short sequence showing a KV cache snapshot flow (redacted) so they can validate that snapshots are customer-initiated and encrypted. Can you provide a tiny sample or a screenshot of the retention UI?
- For the non-training attestation, we need an explicit line saying "Redwood Inference does not use customer-provided content for model training or evaluation for any hosted, dedicated, or private deployment unless authorized in writing by the customer." The current attestation is close but doesn't enumerate the deployment modes.
- Finally, any HubSpot or audit record ID we can reference in our ticket would help (so we can link artifact to your internal evidence).

If you can send an addendum with those three items, we can clear Redwood on our SIG track and move to contract.

Cheers,
Sara
Director, Security Operations — Wellio
